text:
Mira: FYI: after today's driver rollout (CUDA 15.0) to h100-prod we're seeing a perf regression on 512/768 seq text-gen routes — p50 up ~18-22% and cost per token +15%. tagging @eng-runtime

deploy-bot: driver upgrade completed on h100-prod pool (~120 nodes) at 2026-03-17T02:10:00Z

Mike: repro confirmed on canary — 512 seq baseline -> 74ms p50, post-upgrade -> 92ms p50

Alex: quick nsys summary from canary (short):
```
Kernel              Time(ms)   Calls
fused_attn_v1       18.2       320
fused_attn_v2       27.9       320  <-- dominant now
kv_cache_lookup      3.4       320
decoder_token_emit  12.8       1024
```

Alex: autotuner flipped preferred kernel to `fused_attn_v2` for seq <= 800 on compute capability 9.0 — that path seems to regress on larger micro-batch sizes

Tess: kv cache hit rate looks the same in metrics, so this is likely kernel selection not cache staleness. traces show `fused_attn_v2` has higher smem usage leading to lower occupancy for our batch sizes

Sam: tagging @infra — did anything else change (cuda toolkit, driver, libnccl)?

infra: only change was the GPU driver bump to 15.0 and associated cudnn/driver libs; no scheduler changes

Mira: repro script:
```
# run on canary
RD_CLIENT=... python perf_probe.py --model redwood-medium --seq 512 --batch 4 --tokens 1024
```

Mike: perf profile (nsys) shows more L2 cache misses with fused_attn_v2; kernel latency variance up as well — looks sequence-length dependent

Alex: I dumped autotune entries: 
```
{model: redwood-medium, cc:9.0, seq:256->kernel:fused_attn_v1}
{model: redwood-medium, cc:9.0, seq:512->kernel:fused_attn_v2}
```

Tess: hypothesis: autotuner's cost model underestimated the SM occupancy impact for v2 at higher batch*seq -> selects v2 for seq >= 384, but runtime latency grows nonlinearly

Mira: suggestions for mitigation?

Mike: short-term: force config override to prefer `fused_attn_v1` for seq >= 384 on cc9.0. Longer-term: rerun autotune with latest driver in CI and update cost model

Tess: I can push a hotfix flag in serving config: 
```
batching.attention_kernel_override:
  cc_9.0:
    seq_threshold: 384
    preferred: fused_attn_v1
```

Sam: ops note: forcing kernel may change p99 tail. need canary tests. Also need kernel cache flush when rolling back drivers

Mira: plan: 1) push config override to canary 2) run 2h perf sweep 3) if stable, schedule rollback for prod driver to 14.2 or keep 15.0 and force kernel until autotune fix

Alex: quick bench after override on canary -> p50 back to 76ms, p99 slightly better

infra: ops-bot: rollback window opened — rollback driver to 14.2 scheduled at 03:30 UTC (canary first). Alerts on slack and pagerduty

Mira: important: we should also add version pinning in autotune DB so future driver bumps don't auto-flip kernels without validation

Tess: filing follow-up ticket: AUTOTUNE-1293 to add driver/cc to feature vector + add sanity-check regression test on seq-length sweep

Mike: thanks all. anyone object to rolling back prod if canary confirms? :thumbsup:

Alex: +1

Sam: +1

infra: will keep thread updated during rollback

ops-bot: rollback completed on canary at 03:38 UTC, prod rollback in progress

Mira: closing loop once post-rollback perf stable. good catch, team :heart:
